criterion_delta.rationale: R001 inherits every R000 criterion byte-identically; evidence hardening changes result contracts, not mathematical criteria.

changes: Every obligation result carries a repository-relative, hash-bound evidence packet.
PASS requires a registered verifier and direct non-review, non-syntactic evidence for semantic criteria.
Missing packets, source hash drift, and unknown verifiers fail closed.
Prerequisite statuses are recorded explicitly in every packet.
evidence_contract_delta.rationale: The additional contract makes the provenance and derivation of every status machine-auditable without changing hard acceptance.

obligation_graph_delta.rationale: R001 inherits all four R000 obligation graphs byte-identically.

scoring_delta.rationale: R001 preserves the R000 scalar score exactly and adds only a non-authoritative structured progress vector.

status_delta.rationale: R001 remains a shadow child and is not promoted.
